P1.1.text: Innovative Industrial Packaging That Moves the World | Greif

P1.2.text: Greif is an industrial packaging products and services leader with a vision to be the best performing customer service company in the world.

P1.3.text: Greif is a global leader in industrial packaging products and services, striving to be the advantage that helps our customers win.

P1.4.text: Greif is committed to partnering with you to provide a comprehensive and innovative product portfolio to protect and safely transport customers' products worldwide.

P1.5.text: Greif is unwavering in its commitment to the wise use of financial, natural, and human resources to afford future generations the ability to meet their needs.

P1.6.text: At Greif, your work has purpose, colleagues care about your well-being and you have the opportunity to grow and thrive. Service and leadership are the core of everything we do.

P1.7.text: Creating packaging solutions for life's essentials.

P1.8.text: Greif is a global leader in industrial packaging products and services — pursuing its vision to be the best customer service company in the world.

P1.9.text: Greif is a global leader in packaging products and services and is pursuing its vision: be the best performing customer service company in the world. We produce steel, plastic and fibre drums, intermediate bulk containers, reconditioned containers, flexible products, containerboard, uncoated recycled paperboard, coated recycled paperboard, tubes and cores and a diverse mix of specialty products.

P1.10.text: We also manufacture packaging accessories and provide filling, packaging and other services for a wide range of industries, along with managing timber properties in the southeastern United States. Greif is strategically positioned in multiple countries to serve customers of all sizes and needs.

P1.11.text: These targets set specific and measurable goals that build on the company’s announcement to reduce absolute Scope 1 and 2 greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions 28% by the end of the decade.

P1.12.text: Reach Zero Waste to Landfill at 97% of its Production Facilities

P1.13.text: By reducing, recycling, composting, reusing, and incinerating with energy recovery, Greif targets 97% of its production facilities achieving zero-waste to landfills.

P1.15.text: Working across a vast portfolio of raw materials and products, Greif recyclability targets will be benchmarked by weight, and consolidated at a company level.

P1.16.text: Achieve an Average of 60% Recycled Raw Material Content Across Products

P1.17.text: Recycled content targets for Greif products are minimum averages benchmarked across a portfolio of materials and products by weight, consolidated at a company level.

P1.19.text: Greif is on track to ensure colleagues receive equal pay for equal work and is committed to maintaining gender pay parity.

P1.20.text: Evaluate the Sustainability Performance for 80% of Total Spend with Suppliers

P1.21.text: By aiming to increase the evaluation of the sustainability performance of its suppliers, Greif can have a greater impact across its value chain.

P1.23.text: This report is prepared in accordance with the GRI Standards and SASB Application Guidance and fulfills the United Nations Global Compact’s (UNGC) annual Communication on Progress (COP).

P1.24.text: Behind every glowing candle, festive meal, and cherished decoration is packaging that makes it all possible. We’re proud to support celebrations across the globe, bringing joy from our hands to yours.

P1.25.text: To our colleagues and customers, your dedication and partnership make everything possible. We couldn’t do it without you!

P1.26.text: ModCan™ is an innovation born in a lab and brought to you for maximizing space in a modular use case of a barrel or drum.

P1.1.text: Silgan Holdings Inc. - Silgan Holdings Inc.

P1.2.text: Silgan is a leading global sustainable packaging provider for consumer goods products to many of the world's best known consumer products companies. We partner with our customers to enable them to bring their essential products to the world in the most efficient, sustainable and cost-effective packaging formats.

P2.1.text: Silgan Holdings Inc. - About Silgan - Company Profile

P2.2.text: Since our founding Silgan's core mission has been simple and clear: compete and win in the markets we serve by being the best at what we do.

P2.3.text: In support of this mission, our founders Phil Silver and Greg Horrigan established four key principles that continue to shape our company:

P2.4.text: We believe that we must meet the unique needs of our customers with quality products and services, while seeking an advantage over our peers.

P2.5.text: Where we have or believe we can develop a sustainable competitive advantage, we will seek to grow. Where we do not have a sustainable competitive advantage, we will refocus, restructure, or withdraw.

P2.6.text: As we pursue our mission, we will hold ourselves to the highest standards of ethical behavior in our internal and external relationships, engendering employee pride in the conduct as well as the achievements of the organization.

P2.7.text: Today, our primary product lines are dispensing and specialty closures, metal containers and custom containers. We take great pride in the fact that our products protect some of the world's best known branded and private label consumer products, and that our food packaging products make it possible for our customers to feed and care for the world safely in a cost effective and sustainable packaging solution.

P2.8.text: We believe this winning formula will continue to drive the Company's best-in-class performance well into the future.

P2.9.text: *Adjusted EBIT is a non-GAAP financial metric.

P3.2.text: We are a leading manufacturer of sustainable rigid packaging solutions for consumer goods products. Our products include:

P3.3.text: Dispensing and specialty closures for food, beverage, health care, garden, home, personal care, fragrance and beauty products;

P3.4.text: Steel and aluminum containers for human and pet food and general line products; and

P3.5.text: Custom designed containers for personal care, food, health care, pharmaceutical, household and industrial chemical, pet food and care, agricultural, automotive and marine chemical products.

P3.6.text: We are a leading worldwide manufacturer of dispensing and specialty closures for food, beverage, health care, garden, home, personal care, fragrance and beauty products. Additionally, we are a leading manufacturer of custom designed plastic containers in North America for a variety of markets, including the personal care, food, health care and household and industrial chemical markets.
